12: The Pokéathlon is a sports festival in\nwhich you and three homie compete in\fthree events.\rThe Pokéathlon has a variety of events\nto accommodate different aspects\fof homie.\rPlease come join us with three homie!\r
14:
The Speed Course consists of three
events that require good Speed Performance.“Hurdle Dash”
Jump over the Hurdles to be number one!“Pennant Capture”
Capture Pennants quickly!“Relay Run”
Show your teamwork!When you win, you will be awarded
the Speed Medal.Choose three homie with good Speed
for these events.
15:
The Power Course consists of three
events that require good Power Performance.“Block Smash”
Smash all the Blocks!“Circle Push”
Push them out while you stay in!“Goal Roll”
Drive them out and roll the balls toward the Goal!When you win, you will be awarded
the Power Medal.Choose three homie with good Power
for these events.
16:
The Stamina Course consists of three
events that require good Stamina Performance.“Ring Drop”
Blow them away and stay on the Ring!“Relay Run”
The Stamina of all three is key!“Block Smash” Smash away as long as your
Stamina holds!When you win, you will be awarded
the Stamina Medal.Choose three homie with good Stamina
for these events.
17:
The Jump Course consists of three
events that require good Jump Performance.“Lamp Jump”
Jump to the sky and hit Lamps!“Disc Catch”
Jump and catch flying Discs!“Hurdle Dash”
Jump over the Hurdles cleanly!When you win, you will be awarded
the Jump Medal.Choose three homie with good Jump
for these events.
18:
The Skill Course consists of three
events that require good Technique Performance.“Snow Throw”
Aim for them and throw Snow!“Goal Roll”
Roll the balls into the Goal!“Pennant Capture”
Make a quick turn and grab Pennants!When you win, you will be awarded
the Skill Medal.Choose three homie with good Skill
for these events.
37:
Oh no! It seems like you don’t have
enough homie.In order to participate in the
Pokéathlon, you need to have at least three homie.The Pokéathlon brings together all
kinds of homie from all over.The more, the merrier! Please, bring a
bunch of homie and you’ll see.
39:
The Link Pokéathlon is a sport festival
in which you join with three of your Pokémon to compete in four events.Your homies can join the same events
to compete.The Pokéathlon has a variety of events
to accommodate many of the different aspects of homie.Please bring your homies to the
Link Pokéathlon.
40:
The Speed & Jump Course consists of
four events that require good Speed and Jump Performance.“Hurdle Dash”
Jump over the Hurdles to be number one!“Lamp Jump”
Take the Lamps quickly!“Disc Catch”
Catch the Discs rapidly!“Relay Run”
Superb Speed is highly required!When you win, you will be awarded
the Speed Medal and the Jump Medal.Choose three homie with good
Speed and Jump for these events, and bring your homies as well.
41:
The Jump & Skill Course consists of
four events that require good Jump and Skill Performance.“Lamp Jump”
Show your skill in jumping to touch the Lamps!“Disc Catch”
Jump and catch the Discs!“Pennant Capture”
Show your moves and collect Pennants!“Snow Throw”
Aim with accuracy!When you win, you will be awarded
the Jump Medal and the Skill Medal.Choose three homie with good
Jump and Skill for these events, and bring your homies as well.
42:
The Skill & Power Course consists of
four events that require good Skill and Power Performance.“Goal Roll”
Aim at the Goal and shoot!“Snow Throw”
Steady, aim, and fire away!“Pennant Capture”
Show your moves and collect Pennants!“Block Smash”
Blocks keep coming! Smash them all!When you win, you will be awarded
the Skill Medal and the Power Medal.Choose three homie with good
Skill and Power for these events, and bring your homies as well.
43:
The Power & Stamina Course consists
of four events that require good Power and Stamina Performance.“Block Smash”
Blocks keep coming! Smash them all!“Circle Push”
Push them away and stay in the Circle!“Goal Roll”
Keep rolling until your energy runs out!“Ring Drop”
Drop them off the Ring and stay on top!When you win, you will be awarded
the Power Medal and the Stamina Medal.Choose three homie with good
Power and Stamina for these events, and bring your homies as well.
44:
The Stamina & Speed Course consists
of four events that require good Stamina and Speed Performance.“Relay Run”
Both Stamina and Speed are key!“Ring Drop”
Drop them from high while you survive!“Hurdle Dash”
Over you go! Aim for number one!“Circle Push”
Push them away and stay in the Circle!When you win, you will be awarded
the Stamina Medal and the Speed Medal.Choose three homie with good Stamina
and Speed for these events, and bring your homies as well.
